title: Choose Mapa's visual world
question: New hand, steered toward worlds that obviously say 'reminder' and 'call'. The roll assigned The Call Home. Sketches show the caretaker's Today screen.

options.label: The Call Home
options.lineage: the pastel push-button landline every family had, with its coiled cord: calling home, literally
options.thesis: Mapa is a phone call from you: every reminder is a scheduled call, and the coiled cord ties each person to their next one.
materials: frosted glass of a phone screen
options.viewport: Today: each person's bubble at the top, a coiled cord running to their next call time; below, today's calls as a call log (answered, up next, later) with what they said.
options.risk: The cord must stay a signature line, not wallpaper; overused, it turns into retro kitsch.

raised.raise: Times are set as large tabular numerals: the next call's time is the biggest thing on the screen.
Destructive actions (delete reminder, unpair) sit alone, outline-only, and need confirmation.
Each person's phone colour is a code used everywhere (bubble, cord, rows), so colour alone tells you who it is.
During a live call, that call lifts and the rest of the screen dims behind frosted glass.

options.label: Weekly Pill Box
options.lineage: the 7-day M-T-W-T-F-S-S pill organiser with translucent coloured lids
options.thesis: The app is the pill box: each day's lid pops open when Mapa hears 'yes, I took it'.
options.viewport: Today: this week's pill box across the top, today's lid glowing; below, today's calls with status.
options.risk: The most obvious object for this category, so it's where most runs land, and it can tip toward pharmacy.

options.label: Day Line
options.thesis: Each person's day is a coloured line, and every dose is a station you pass.
options.viewport: Today: one line per person running across the day, with stations at 9:00, 13:30 and 20:00 (filled = taken).
options.case: Strong clarity for a whole day at a glance, but less warm and less obviously about calling.
options.risk: Reads as commute and logistics rather than care.

options.label: Growing Together
options.thesis: Each person has a plant that grows one stage with every dose they take.
options.viewport: Today: Amma's plant at stage 12 above the call list; a missed dose wilts a leaf.
options.case: Warm and Waterllama-like for identification, but the plant doesn't say 'call' or 'medicine'.
options.risk: A missed dose wilting the plant can feel like guilt.

options.label: Datamatics
options.case: Cold and abstract, so it loses on both axes.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.kept: Person colour as a consistent code.

options.label: Title Wall
options.thesis: Rows of tiles that lift on focus.
options.kept: The focused live call lifts while the rest dims.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Duolingo-style habit app, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A white Today screen with a streak flame, a green CTA and a mascot speech bubble.
canonCard.risk: It looks like every gamified app, which is the 'generic' you ruled out.
